protocol.event_basis: compile_basis=True on the same five numeric targets; two semantic events (relevant, relevant-and-exact)
protocol.risk: alpha divided evenly across stratum-event sequences whose remaining population is non-empty
protocol.projection: build_polytope and ratio_bounds, the partition-aware projection, same function for both arms
protocol.deterministic_counts: both arms insert every historical label into obs before the first new call
stopping: a confidence sequence returns no feasible count; open targets are not certified

arms.T: tcache via add_targeted; confidence sequence on the full stratum; history event offset E_f=0
arms.E: cache as known mass; confidence sequence on the records outside the history; E_f is the exact history count
